strings.game.snowball.arena_summit: On the summit, in the wind
strings.game.snowball.characters_note: The characters are the crew, in their jacket colors from the other games. The arenas, wind and opponents are made up for the game.
strings.game.snowball.hint: Drag up to stand and aim, let go to throw. When you're not aiming, you're safe behind the wall
strings.game.snowball.how_drag_text: up from anywhere on the screen. You rise above the wall, and a circle shows where the ball would land without wind.
strings.game.snowball.how_duck_text: when you lift your finger. A ball coming at you? Don't stand up now.
strings.game.snowball.how_release_text: and the ball flies. The wind pushes it aside, so aim a little against it.
strings.game.snowball.intro: You're behind your wall, the crew behind theirs. Stand up, aim, throw, and duck before their snowball arrives.
strings.game.snowball.meta_description: A snowball fight among the crew, with crumbling walls and wind
strings.game.snowball.title: Snowball Fight
